lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Final hand. Heads-up for the Biscayne Classic, and the whole card room is standing on chairs.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: The last card hits the felt. The Biscayne Classic is yours.

lines.name: MUSTICH
lines.text: Enjoy it. Dad says the Classic is a rounding error.

lines.name: TOMMY
lines.text: Don't listen to him, kid. Thirty years I've been chasing that trophy. You earned it.

lines.name: MILES
lines.text: Your name goes on the board by the cage. Permanent marker. Congratulations.
